notes.title: What's next?
notes.notes:
[b]So what is happening currently with the next episode of Cowpocalypse? [/b]

I got many positive feedbacks from you guys about the game and it was a really amazing feeling as this was my first ever game I made. So many of you are waiting to continue the story of Bran and the Cows so I wanted to post an update about it. Well Covid didn't make my life easier either so for an indefinite period I need to delay the project. It is really difficult for me to make a living and make the game at the same time considering that making the game itself requires a lot of money too. 

I am still really excited about it so I will deffinitely finish it sooner or later but at the moment it is not clear for me when this will happen. So there it is. I hope you can hear from me and the next episode as soon as possible. Until then stay safe and good luck with any project you might get into!

notes.title: Swimming is hard
notes.notes:
It won't happen.

To sum my experience with Indiegogo: I can't start a campaign from my country, Hungary because Indiegogo updated their policy recently. An email was sent to me by Indiegogo on August 5 saying that I should launch the campagin before August 12. As it was summer I didn't check my email in that period so I missed the deadline. I find this "one week notice" ridiculous. I spent a huge ammount of time preparing the campagin itself, not to mention my business plan was from the start of the development that I make Ep1 free on Steam so I could launch the campaign of Ep2 on Indiegogo. I wrote an email to the Indiegogo support about their mishandled situation and all I got was a sample copypaste letter. I feel they made a mistake, and they didn't even acknowledge it when I raised their attention. It's really sad.

[b]I can't recommend Indeigogo to anyone now. They might change something else for you in a blink of an eye. Use Kickstarter instead if you can. Or anything else.[/b]

So I guess that's it for now. I really appreciate every support so far, but I can't cross the river right now. The ship (Indiegogo) I bought a ticket for changed it's seats at the last minute forbidding Hungarian passangers (among other nations) to get aboard.

The other side is still there though. I might find an other way to cross the river in the future. One can never know for sure, maybe you guys will hear from Episode 2 in the future!

Best whishes for everyone!

Balazs

notes.title: Hope? It is always there!
notes.notes:
I really tought it was over. Besides Kicktarter and Indiegogo, I ckecked many sites and none allowed projects from Hungary. But then I got an email with a link to GoGetFunding. Whaaat? They allow? They do.

I don't want to get too excited, so I'm not promisiong you anything either. I still have to look into their conditions. But let me just say this: There is hope!

notes.title: Bad news: Indiegogo won't happen
notes.notes:
[h1]It's a really depressing feeling that after a huge ammount of preparation it turns out that I can't start a campaign from my country, Hungary. [/h1]

It shocked me, because the last time I checked I was on the eligable list (about 1 year ago). I don't know if Indiegogo updated their policy since then, or I was reading an outdated info before. In any case, I can't really do anything about it. I'm sorry that I made you guys excited and now I let you down. Believe me, it's a horrible news for me too. 

I believe that honesty is the best way to go. So here it is: without support I can't make Episode 2, so it surely won't happen in the near future. I hope that in the distant future I could start working on it, because I really enjoyed the development, but it's out of my sight for now.
[b]
Thanks for all the positive feedback I got for the game so far! I whish the best for everyone and that your dreams come true![/b]
